methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: The VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership explicitly targets broad community AI education and innovation, signaling intentional infrastructure for distributed, peer-driven AI fluency beyond elite institutions—a direct investment in the 'deep & distributed' pathway.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - WAVY.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's exploration of AI-powered non-emergency call dispatch represents shallow, platform-delivered automation—government adopting turnkey AI tools without building internal capability, exemplifying distributed but non-transformative adoption.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools bringing ChatGPT under division oversight shows concentrated institutional capacity to govern AI in K-12, but limited to well-resourced districts—a marker of metro capability gaps rather than statewide fluency infrastructure.

signals.title: Southwest Field Notes: National Black Lung Association to meet next week in Abingdon amid historic high numbers of the disease in central Appalachia
signals.signal_reading: Southwest Virginia's focus on black lung disease and community meals while NoVA debates data center billions illustrates the fundamental infrastructure and economic gaps that prevent AI capability from reaching Appalachian communities—neither depth nor distribution materializes here.

signals.title: Fairfax City Business Leaders Tell Spanberger About Rising Costs, AI, Workforce Challenges - Patch
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax business leaders discussing AI with federal representatives signals concentrated policy influence and workforce sophistication in NoVA's innovation core, reinforcing metro advantage while rural regions lack comparable business-government AI dialogue infrastructure.
